› Fix the flaky login test in app/tests/login.rs and keep the other app tests green.

• I'll read the failing test and the session helper it uses first.

• Explored
  └ Read login.rs, session.rs
    Search wait_for_cookie in app

• Ran cargo test -p app login -- --nocapture
  └ running 12 tests
    test login::rejects_bad_password ... ok
    test login::rejects_unknown_user ... ok
    test login::sets_the_session_cookie ... ok
    test login::keeps_session_after_refresh ... FAILED
    thread 'login::keeps_session_after_refresh' panicked at app/tests/login.rs:88:5: assertion failed: session.cookie().is_some(); the cookie was read before the refresh response set it, so the as
    sertion saw an empty jar
    test result: FAILED. 11 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 2.31s

• The test sleeps for 200 ms and then reads the session cookie, so it races the refresh request that sets it. On a busy machine the refresh takes longer than the sleep and the jar is still empty when
  the assertion runs. The session helper already has wait_for_cookie, which polls the jar until the cookie is there or a timeout passes, so the test can wait for the cookie itself instead of a fixed
  time. I'll switch the test to it and keep the 5 second timeout the other session tests use, so a real failure still ends the test quickly instead of hanging the whole suite on a missing cookie.

• Edited app/tests/login.rs (+3 -2)
    84       let session = Session::login(&app, "alice", "secret").await?;
    85       session.refresh().await?;
    86 -     sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
    87 -     assert!(session.cookie().is_some());
    86 +     let cookie = session.wait_for_cookie(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
    87 +     assert!(cookie.is_some(), "the refresh must keep the session cookie");
    88 +     assert_eq!(session.user().await?.name, "alice");

• Ran cargo test -p app
  └ running 58 tests
    test result: ok. 58 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 4.02s

• Ran cargo clippy -p app --all-targets -- -D warnings
  └ Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 9.87s

• The login test now waits for the session cookie with the helper the other session tests use, instead of sleeping for a fixed 200 ms, so it no longer depends on how fast the refresh request is.
  All 58 app tests pass and clippy is clean. The change is limited to app/tests/login.rs; the session code itself was already correct.
